# Atlas and Library editorial previews

Downloaded from the owner's public product landing pages on 2026-11-04.

- `atlas-study.webp`: https://themedatlas.vercel.app/marketing/study.png, actual Atlas study interface (1280 × 900). Original 3D anatomy and source attributions remain within the Atlas product. Preview is an educational interface capture, not clinical guidance.
- `library-acervo.webp`: https://themedlibrary.vercel.app/landing/acervo.png, actual Library catalog interface (1440 × 1000, resized to 1400 × 972). Visible catalog counts describe the captured edition, not a live total.

Converted to WebP for delivery. No claim of third-party institutional partnership or subscription access is made. Public pages disclose Club activation is still in preparation. Links open the respective product landing pages, not an activation flow.
